derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G4483 (ῥέω);

occurrences.text: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
